# Tokalator

> Open-source context engineering for AI coding assistants (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Living code maps for agents (GLOSSARY.md and SITE-MAP.md), a VS Code extension that tracks context budgets and Claude Code turns with API-equivalent cost, an MCP server and CLI, and browser-based token and pricing tools for 32 Claude, GPT, and Gemini models. Updated 2026-10-10.

Tokalator helps developers see what fills the context window, what a session costs, and which files matter. Everything runs locally or in the browser. Telemetry in the extension is opt-in and off by default.

## VS Code extension (4.1.1)

- [Extension overview, live dashboard demo, settings, and commands](https://tokalator.ai/extension): context budget meter, tab relevance scoring and cleanup, pinned files, Turn Analytics (growth per turn, turns remaining), input-only turn cost with long-context pricing.
- Claude Code tracking: reads local Claude Code session logs (CLI and VS Code extension) for the workspace and shows turns, requests, cache hit rate, context size per turn, and API-equivalent cost, refreshed every 15 seconds without chat mentions.
- GitHub Copilot: detects the active Copilot chat model and switches the context window and prices; counts @tokalator turns. VS Code does not expose Copilot's token usage to other extensions, so Copilot cost is an input-only estimate.
- @tokalator chat commands: /count, /breakdown, /optimize, /pin, /unpin, /instructions, /model, /compaction, /preview, /secure, /skill-gen, /settings-gen, /pricewatch, /reset, /exit.
- Secure Workspace writes deny rules for Claude Code, Copilot chat exclusions, and .gitignore entries for secret files.
- API-equivalent cost means what the tokens would cost at API list prices; Claude Pro, Max, and Team plans are not billed per token.
- [Marketplace listing](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=vfaraji89.tokalator)

## Tools (run in the browser)

- [Claude Code usage](https://tokalator.ai/tools/usage): drop ~/.claude/projects logs to see turns, requests, cache hits, and API-equivalent cost by model, project, client, and day. Files are not uploaded.
- [Cost calculator](https://tokalator.ai/tools/calculator): compare request cost across all catalog models, with cache and long-context rates.
- [Model comparison](https://tokalator.ai/tools/compare) and [pricing reference](https://tokalator.ai/tools/pricing): rates per million tokens, context windows, and provider sources.
- [Prompt caching](https://tokalator.ai/tools/caching), [conversation growth](https://tokalator.ai/tools/conversation), [context budget](https://tokalator.ai/tools/context), [economics](https://tokalator.ai/tools/economics).

## Learn

- [Learn](https://tokalator.ai/learn): lessons on context windows, server-side compaction, context editing, prompt caching, effort, and tool search, with sources.
- [Dictionary](https://tokalator.ai/dictionary): context engineering terms (MCP, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, cache TTL, long-context pricing, preserved thinking, and more).
- [Wiki](https://tokalator.ai/wiki): arXiv papers on long context, context rot, prompt caching, and agent context files.

## MCP server and CLI

- [tokalator-mcp](https://tokalator.ai/extension#mcp): MCP tools count_tokens, estimate_budget, preview_turn, list_models, and claude_code_usage for Claude Code; the same as a terminal CLI (tokalator count, budget, preview, models, usage --watch).
